name: Juuichi Chito
source:
A boy in the second year of junior high school. Momoka's twin brother and Ren's childhood friend. He pretends to be a delinquent, but since he is serious at heart, he has turned into a delinquent.

He is not good at studying, but he is good at sports. He's always been swayed by Ren anyway, and lately he's learned to resist.

[Translated from [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/llfl.html#story]official website[/url]]
